definitions.gloss: several vehicles or machines; a few units
definitions.explanation: An unspecified small number — usually a few to several — of things counted with the counter {台|だい} (cars, machines, appliances). The prefix {数|すう} attaches to a counter to mean "several."

examples.japanese: ⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{数台|すうだい}⟦{止|と}まっている→止まる：00555_tomaru⟧。
⟦{会場|かいじょう}→会場：01269_kaijou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦パソコン→パソコン：01538_pasokon⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{数台|すうだい}⟦{並|なら}んでいた→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧。
examples.english: Several computers were lined up at the venue.

examples.japanese: ⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{道路|どうろ}→道路：01481_douro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{重機|じゅうき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{数台|すうだい}⟦{入|はい}っている→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: Several pieces of heavy machinery are on the road for the construction work.

notes:
The prefix ⟦{数|すう}→数：03360_suu⟧ attaches to a counter to mean "several" or "a few" (typically two to eight or so). With {台|だい}, the counter for vehicles and machines, {数台|すうだい} means several cars, computers, appliances, and the like.

THE {数|すう}〜 PATTERN:
- ⟦{数人|すうにん}→数人：18787_suunin⟧: several people
- ⟦{数回|すうかい}→数回：29820_suukai⟧: several times
- ⟦{数日|すうじつ}→数日：20517_suujitsu⟧: several days

Use {数台|すうだい} only for things counted with {台|だい}; switch the counter to match other kinds of objects.
